name: Rizuhble's Jumper Cables Graves
rows: Sell it late for a counter.
Sell Extra Regen for this if you have it.
Dying after Capacitor? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Split Shot.
One gun hero is deleting you. Pop it and keep shooting.
Slows, hexes and burns like Infernus's.
Their damage is big spirit hits.
Stuns keep stopping you shooting late.
On Jar of Dead. Sell Surge of Power for this.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Base: Kieran's in-game build, items and order kept through Escalating Exposure. His late box sold Grit for Ricochet (Grit had already become Spirit Shielding), Spirit Lifesteal for Siphon (while Leech in Slot locked still upgraded it) and ended on 11 slots at 57.6k. Fixed with the components: Spiritual Overflow is built from Spirit Lifesteal (so it's a +4800 upgrade, no sell needed, and Leech can't also upgrade it — Leech dropped), Siphon now sells Spirit Shielding, Ricochet sells only a lane item. Core = 12 slots at 49.6k: Ricochet 32k, Escalating Exposure 38.4k, Siphon 44.8k, Spiritual Overflow 49.6k.

Silencer (6400) moved from core to the top of the rich box with his 'sell Healbane' note — it was the 13th item and took the build to 56k. Divine Barrier moved from rich to Counters (pricier Dispel Magic, rule 27) so rich stays at 8.

Surge of Power imbue moved from Essence Theft (3) to Jar of Dead (1): Essence Theft is a passive (no cast in the ability data), so Surge's active half (+20% fire rate, full speed while shooting for 8s on cast) never fired and its +28 spirit only added 0.25×28 = 7 stolen damage; on the jar (4 charges, 13s) the buff is up almost always and the skulls get +7 per hit.

Lane box is survival-only: Close Quarters (pure damage) removed, Point Blank with it. Improved Spirit's 'Upgrade.' was false (Extra Spirit had already become Surge) — now a fresh T2 at 11.2k, and Boundless Spirit added to Slot locked so it isn't a T2 held forever. Active Reload's 'every 13th shot hits double' claim isn't in the weapon data (no hit counter on Graves' gun), so the note is just 'quick reloads keep you shooting'.

Spikes unchanged: gun 4.8k at Active Reload (7.2k souls), spirit 4.8k at Improved Spirit (11.2k), gun 8k at Toxic (14.4k), health 5.6k at Healbane (18.4k) and 8k at Stamina Mastery (20.8k), gun 11.2k at Capacitor (24k). Sells added for the full core (Split Shot / Active Reload / Toxic / Healbane), Mercurial Magnum given its imbue target, 'beam' → 'shoot', Witchmail/Divine Barrier no longer called upgrades.
Mid box had 9 items; split into Mid · L-R (8) + Mid · cont. per the layout rule, order unchanged.

Ability order: Kieran's in-game order kept for the first 7 points (Jar, Hands, Essence Theft T1+T2 = +20 stolen weapon damage for the gun), then ult T1/T2 at 8-9 like both seemeta orders (most-popular 61.5%: 112344422234331; highest-WR 65%: 112314413332224), Theft maxed at 11 (skulls apply it), Jar maxed before Hands because Surge/Mercurial sit on the jar, ult T3 (5% current-health) last as in Kieran's and the highest-WR order.
Threshold: no damage-threshold items. Spiritual Overflow/Toxic Bullets are build-up on shooting (40-round, 0.1s gun). Witchmail only in the rich box. No change.

Round 10: Toxic Bullets (3.2k) moved from 14.4k to right after Healbane, so the 4.8k health spike lands at 15.2k (was 18.4k) and Toxic at 18.4k. Graves fights close (gun falloff starts at about 8m, Grit/Extra Stamina notes say walk onto people), so by the rule the health spike comes before more big damage once the gun (7.2k) and spirit (11.2k) spikes are in. seemeta Graves, Oct 5-19 2026: Toxic Bullets bought at 19:56 on average, after Grit (10:17) and Spirit Shielding (15:19). Toxic note: "Stacks instantly" was not true (it builds up per shot), reworded.

Round 10: notes made true: Capacitor said "Your spirit spike" (it is a gun item; spirit 4.8k is Improved Spirit), Healbane and Escalating Exposure work off spirit damage (Tesla, skulls), not bullets, and Ricochet now says why (bounces carry Tesla/Toxic procs).

Round 11: Ricochet now before Split Shot, so the 6.4k buys from 25.6k are no longer four in a row (Ricochet 30.4k, Split Shot 32k, then Escalating Exposure, Siphon Bullets, Spiritual Overflow late). Added "Lost lane?" reorder box: farm items earlier.
Round 12: Split Shot moved from 32k (a fresh 1.6k item bought late and sold later) to right after Toxic Bullets at 20k, next to the other farm items. Lost lane? reorder updated to match.

Round 12: Rich box trimmed to pricier versions of what the build does: removed Refresher ("not needed"), Cursed Relic and Phantom Strike (different jobs) and Witchmail (it was the pricier Spirit Shielding, but Spirit Shielding is sold for Siphon Bullets). Lucky Shot and Mercurial Magnum both sold Active Reload; Lucky Shot now sells Split Shot.
Round 12: Lane notes say these are first buys: Restorative Shot and Extra Regen are sold later and upgrade into nothing, so they only pay off bought first.
Round 13: notes cut to niche tips, timings, imbue targets, sells and upgrades only (Kieran 00:05); desc is now just the style label.

Round 13: Surge of Power checked by kit: on Jar of Dead (4 charges, 13s between) every throw gives +20% fire rate and full speed while shooting for 8s, so it's up almost all fight; that's a gun item for Graves. Kept. Improved Spirit (+18 spirit only adds ~3 per Tesla chain at 0.19x) swapped for Mystic Slow, same colour and price so spikes don't move, from SWZTCH's Graves Slurp (lockbuilds, Oct 14, gun: Restorative Shot, Opening Rounds; Tesla, Stamina Mastery, Titanic; Mystic Slow/Burst Fire/Toxic; Ricochet, Inhibitor; Silencer; Siphon/Spiritual Overflow). Boundless Spirit slot-locked line removed with it.

Round 14: notes cut to triggers and sells: lane items, Split Shot (Tesla is a 15% chance, not every bullet), Mystic Slow (proc explanation), Bullet Resilience ('cheap', it's 3.2k). False counter notes fixed: Counterspell blocks, it doesn't send the burst back (now 'Lash ult, Infernus ult.'); Spellbreaker isn't a dispel (now 'big spirit hits'). Rich notes cut to sells; Inhibitor builds up per shot (0.77 a shot), it isn't instant; Lucky Shot now sells Mystic Slow (Split Shot was also the Counters sell). Divine Barrier moved from Counters to the rich box as the pricier Dispel Magic. 'Lost lane?' said to move Toxic and Split Shot, which already come right after Healbane; it now moves Ricochet ahead of Stamina Mastery and Capacitor (32k to 26.4k).

Round 15: Restorative Shot removed (Kieran dislikes it except on shotgun heroes; Graves is not one), lane box is Extra Regen only. Spirit Shielding, Spirit Lifesteal and Healbane moved before Surge of Power and Mystic Slow so health 4.8k lands at 11.2k (was 15.2k, after the spirit spike) on a close-range hero. Silencer removed from rich (not a pricier version of anything in the build); Inhibitor is now the pricier anti-heal and sells Healbane. "Lost lane?" box removed: the reorder only took effect at 20k souls, long after lane.
Round 17: Spirit Shielding and Surge of Power notes drop "Upgrade."; Dispel Magic note drops "DoTs"; Divine Barrier note uses the standard wording.
Round 19: checked against current public builds of this style; it is a real style, no changes.
Round 20: late list to 81.6k: Inhibitor first, Silencer and Cheat Death added (FaxFox 404608), Mercurial Magnum now sells Surge of Power (both on Jar of Dead).

Round 23 (kit): Jar of Dead T2 already slows 24% for 1s on every Deadhead hit (ab.py ability_necro_hauntingskull SlowPercent 24), and Jar T2 is taken at 7.2k, before Mystic Slow (24%, 15.2k), so Mystic Slow added almost nothing. Replaced by Mystic Vulnerability (same 1.6k, same spirit colour, spikes unchanged): -8% spirit resist from every Deadhead and ghoul hit, and it upgrades into Escalating Exposure, which the build already buys (now +4.8k instead of 6.4k). That freed a core slot, so Lucky Shot moves from the late list to the end of Late (25% of beam bullets deal double). Late list: Inhibitor, Silencer, Mercurial Magnum, Cheat Death, Divine Barrier.
Round 25: ability order 1123433441322214 -> 1123433441321224 (playstyle-based; see a25/log/graves.md).
